definitions.explanation: a licensed professional who handles legal documents, particularly real estate registration and corporate registration

examples.japanese: {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: I asked a judicial scrivener to handle the registration.

examples.japanese: {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧だ。
examples.english: Judicial scriveners are experts in real estate registration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{司法|しほう}{書士|しょし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せた→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: I left the company incorporation procedures to a judicial scrivener.

notes:
SCOPE OF WORK:
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧ - real estate registration
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧ - commercial registration
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧ - company incorporation
- ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ - inheritance procedures
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ - debt restructuring (limited)

CONTRAST WITH OTHER LEGAL PROFESSIONALS:
- ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧ - lawyer (litigation, legal advice)
- {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし} - judicial scrivener (registration, documents)
- ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}{書士|しょし}→行政書士：08748_gyouseishoshi⟧ - administrative scrivener (government permits)
- ⟦{税理士|ぜいりし}→税理士：06571_zeirishi⟧ - tax accountant

JAPAN-SPECIFIC:
This profession is unique to Japan. In other countries, these tasks are typically handled by lawyers or notaries.
